comment: Strokes at radius 30 whose discs reach a 1920 by 1080 canvas from its far edges and from past them. At Fit the canvas's last row sits on the window's own bottom edge, where no press lands , so the view is zoomed out first and every edge has grey beyond it. The texel step reads each stroke's paint inside the canvas, and one texel of the stroke along y 1110, whose disc ends on the edge line and covers no texel.
Along the last row's far edge, y 1080, and along the last column's, x 1920, and a corner stroke through both.
Past the edge with the disc still reaching ten rows in, and past it with the disc ending on the edge line.
The bottom right corner brought to the centre by a middle drag and looked at close.
